slice: Act 1 -- The Crack Under the Couch
sampleRate: 44100 Hz (music/SFX render) / 44100 Hz (voice TTS render), all exported mono OGG Vorbis

cues.purpose: Quiet, dusty room-tone bed for the entry chamber -- loops under all Act 1 gameplay.
Short goofy success sting layered with sfx/toll-gate-open.ogg when Old Bottlecap accepts the button.
Confirmation blip when a hotspot or dialogue choice is selected.
Descending blip when backing out of a menu or dialogue.
Pip's footstep on the under-couch floor, variant 1; alternate with variant 2.
Pip's footstep, variant 2; alternate with variant 1.
Soft reveal chime when searching the dust clump uncovers the button (act01-005).
Small metallic clink when the button is actually added to inventory.
Soft cardboard creak when inspecting the Lost & Found Cubby Wall.
Page-turn when inspecting the Sign-In Log (act01-011).
Soft heavy thud on the popcorn-kernel boulder's permanent use-fail (act01-013).
Soft cloth/web rustle when inspecting the cobweb curtain, just before Scuttle's cameo.
Fast skitter under Scuttle's one-shot cameo dash-through (act01-015).
Soft dismissive knock when Old Bottlecap refuses entry without the toll (act01-038).
Grate sliding open, layered with music/toll-paid-stinger.ogg -- the act's climax beat.
Ambient paper-shuffle one-shot during Bramble's passive furniture-anchored idle loop, played periodically, not player-triggered.

voiceDialogueNote: Voice lines are ElevenLabs TTS, free tier -- non-commercial, requires ElevenLabs attribution, not cleared to ship as-is. See script/ACT_01_DIALOGUE.json and README.md's Voice audio section. 45 of 49 Act 1 lines are voiced; the free-tier monthly quota ran out on the last 4 generic fallback lines.
sourcingNote: All music and SFX are Freesound.org recordings (CC0 or CC-BY only), trimmed/normalized/gain-matched by functional category (footstep/ui/interaction/reward/ambient_character/music_loop/music_stinger targets) rather than used verbatim or left at inconsistent source loudness.
